author: Sioux Falls SD Daily Brief
title: 🛒 Sioux Falls Retail Jobs With Multiple Roles Up to $35/hr
text:
1 days ago Sioux Falls has a nice mix of retail gigs right now—from big box stores to local healthcare gift shops—many with solid pay and real growth paths.
Here are several customer service and retail openings worth a look:
Dairy/Frozen Manager Employer: Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time Pay: $20.00/hour
Lead the dairy, frozen, deli, and meat areas, manage ordering and margins, and act as Manager on Duty. Comes with strong benefits, regular raises, and lots of wellness-focused perks. Personal Banker – Sioux Falls Employer: Wells Fargo Location: Multiple branches across Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time
Help customers with everyday banking, new accounts, and basic credit needs while building long-term relationships. Good fit if you like structured training, career growth, and a mix of sales and service. Assistant Manager (Full Time) Employer: Tillys Location: 4001 W 41st St, Sioux Falls, SD 57106 Type: Full-time
Support the store manager, coach associates, and keep the store running smoothly. Great if you have retail experience and want a people-focused leadership role. Part Time Seasonal Retail Associate – Duluth Trading Employer: Duluth Trading Company Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Part-time, seasonal Pay: $15.00–$15.50/hour
Help customers find rugged gear, keep the floor stocked, and ring up sales. Flexible scheduling, 40% employee discount , and daily pay option. Retail Sales Associate Employer: Verizon Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week) Pay: $16–$21/hour base + up to $18,000+/year commission (top performers $65,000–$75,500+ annually )
Sell cutting-edge wireless tech, earn strong commissions, and get day-one benefits, tuition help, and big discounts on Verizon services. Customer Service Account Manager (Representative I, Customer Service) Employer: Inovar Packaging Group Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time
Act as main contact for B2B customers from order to shipment in a fast-paced manufacturing setting. Offers competitive pay + bonus and full benefits, ideal if you like detailed order management. Retail Operations Associate Employer: DICK'S Sporting Goods Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Part-time
Work behind the scenes unloading trucks, organizing the backroom, and keeping the sales floor ready. Good for someone who likes physical work and a sports-focused environment. Retail Outdoor Associate Employer: DICK'S Sporting Goods – House of Sport Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Part-time
Help campers, hikers, and anglers find the right gear while keeping outdoor departments looking sharp. Great if you already love the outdoors and want to share that knowledge. Retail Omni Fulfillment Lead Employer: DICK'S Sporting Goods Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time
Lead the team that handles online orders, pickups, and inventory presentation. A solid step-up role if you have store experience and want leadership responsibilities. Retail Rock Climbing Lead Employer: DICK'S Sporting Goods Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time
Run the in-store climbing wall, teach techniques, and oversee safety and staff training. Perfect for certified climbers who want a unique mix of instruction and retail leadership. Shift Lead Employer: Walgreens Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time Pay: $17–$20/hour
Open/close the store, handle cash, support the front end, and model great customer service. Good fit if you have at least a year of retail/key-holder or supervisory experience. Assistant Store Manager Employer: Central Network Retail Group (CNRG) Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time Pay: $21.00/hour
Second-in-command for the store—lead the team, oversee merchandising, and support commercial sales. Includes employee discount, 401(k) with match , and full-time benefits. Assistant Manager – 6509 South Louise Ave Employer: Holiday Stationstores (Circle K) Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time
Support store operations, help hire and train staff, and keep food and convenience items running smoothly. Offers weekly pay, bonuses, benefits, and quick promotion potential. Team Member – 6509 South Louise Ave Employer: Holiday Stationstores (Circle K) Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Part-time
Frontline customer role: greet guests, run the register, and help with food and store upkeep. Weekly pay, bonus potential, and a good entry point into retail. Team Member – 4600 West 41st Street Employer: Holiday Stationstores (Circle K) Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Part-time
Similar customer service role at a different store location, with flexible shifts and room to grow into leadership if you want. Assistant Manager – 4600 West 41st Street Employer: Holiday Stationstores (Circle K) Location: Sioux Falls, SD Type: Full-time
Another assistant manager opportunity, this time on W 41st St, with the same strong benefits and fast-paced c-store environment. Gift Shop Associate – Weekends Employer: Sanford Health Location: East Patient Building, 1305 W 18th St, Sioux Falls, SD 57117 Type: PRN (weekend hours) Pay range: $15.00–$22.50/hour
Work Saturdays and Sundays in the hospital gift shop, ringing up sales, stocking, and delivering gifts to patient rooms. Nice pick if you want weekend work in a healthcare setting.
